text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан is defeated at the Arima
Kinen, yet
Hishi Amazon can't come to
terms with her own
victory, having
overcome what she long viewed as
an
insurmountable wall.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан bluntly tells her to accept
the results.
She adds that she isn't the
type to lose once and
just give up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The new year brings the start of her
senior year,
and our next goal—the
Hanshin Daishoten.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
